notes.title: Wild Mutation - An Important Development Update
notes.content:
Dear Wild Mutation Community,

I am writing to personally extend my heartfelt gratitude for your continuous support and excitement for my game, Wild Mutation.

It is with a heavy heart that I must announce a further delay in the game's public release. As a solo indie game developer, I faced unexpected challenges during the development/publishing process, leading to the initial 30-day delay. However, I believe that this additional time is essential to deliver the best possible experience to all of you.

The new estimated release date for Wild Mutation's Early Access is now set for the end of Q4 2023. I apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and promise that this decision was made with the utmost care and dedication to delivering a game that meets and exceeds your expectations.

Currently, the [b]closed beta testing[/b] is in full swing, and I am grateful to my amazing beta testers for their valuable feedback and support. Their efforts have been invaluable in helping me identify and address various issues.

During this time, I am dedicating myself to refining the game's core mechanics, optimizing performance, and addressing reported bugs. Additionally, I am undertaking a much-needed UI overhaul to give Wild Mutation a unique and immersive feel.

I, as the founder and game developer at Reality Scape Studios, am committed to creating a memorable and engaging survival experience for all players. I understand the importance of providing a polished and well-crafted game, and I am working tirelessly to achieve this.

I want to thank you once again for your patience and understanding. Your unwavering support means the world to me, and I can't wait to share Wild Mutation with you all. Rest assured, every delay brings us closer to delivering a game that we can all be proud of.

As I continue my journey towards the release, I will keep you updated on my progress through monthly devlogs and announcements. Together, we will venture into the unique and captivating world of Wild Mutation, embracing the challenges and thrills of survival in a sci-fi dystopian landscape.

Thank you for being a part of this incredible journey with me. Your support fuels my passion and determination to make Wild Mutation an unforgettable experience.

Stay tuned for more updates and exciting content as we approach the launch of Wild Mutation.

Sincerely,

Ivan Valdivia
Founder & Game Developer, Reality Scape Studios

notes.title: Wild Mutation Demo Update: Release Delayed, Bigger Map and Enhanced Gameplay
notes.content:
Greetings Survivors,

We have an important update regarding the release of the Wild Mutation demo. We apologize for the delay, but rest assured it's for a good reason! We have been working tirelessly to improve the game and provide you with a more immersive and exciting experience.

The demo, originally scheduled for release last month(June 2023), will now be launching by the end of this month(July 2023). We wanted to take some extra time to clean up the code, optimize performance, and make significant additions to the game world.

One of the key improvements is the expansion of the demo map. We have made it bigger, allowing for more exploration and discovery. You'll encounter new interactive buildings that offer unique gameplay opportunities. Each building has been carefully crafted to provide a distinct atmosphere and contain valuable resources and lootables for you to scavenge.

In addition, we have added a wide range of new interactable items throughout the map. From abandoned vehicles and hidden caches to forgotten locations of the old world, there are plenty of secrets to uncover. Explore every nook and cranny, as you never know what valuable items or useful tools you might find.

We understand the excitement and anticipation surrounding the Wild Mutation demo, and we want to ensure that it lives up to your expectations. The delay allows us to deliver a more polished and engaging experience right from the start.

We appreciate your patience and support during this process. We remain committed to creating a thrilling sci-fi survival game that will captivate your imagination. We can't wait to share the Wild Mutation demo with you very soon.

Stay tuned for further updates and announcements. Thank you for your understanding and continued support.

Best regards,

Reality Scape Studios
